name: Vault Tablet
description: A stone tablet inscribed with a map showing the locations of other sealed vaults. The spiral sigils on its surface pulse faintly with cold blue light. It also functions as a key — pressing it against a vault's seal will open it.
notes: Corvus will pay 50gp for this. The Grey Exchange will pay much more. Keeping it means the party controls who opens the remaining vaults.

name: Sir Aldric's Shield
description: A battered wooden shield bearing the faded emblem of the Silver Hand. In the presence of undead, the emblem glows with warm golden light, granting +1 to AC against undead attacks.
notes: Tharivol's starting equipment. The glow is a minor enchantment placed by the Silver Hand. It's sentimental more than powerful.
